task.name: Size-efficient sorting networks on 18 wires
task.description: Construct a compare-exchange network that sorts all 18-input sequences with as few comparators as possible; correctness is certified over all 262,144 Boolean inputs. The best known network has 77 comparators; the lower bound is 68, so the optimal size is open. The seed odd-even transposition network uses 153 comparators.
task.contract: construct() -> ordered list of integer pairs (i, j), 0 <= i < j < N. Each compare-exchange writes min to wire i and max to j. The network must sort every input. Score: comparator count, minimized; parallel depth is reported separately. Maximum 4096 comparators.
